mechanism: On a chosen HTF, scan bars_check candles with lookback z: a swing low (high) is bar i whose extreme is strictly lower (higher) than z neighbors each side. Support zone = [low[i], MathMin(open,close)]; resistance = [MathMax(open,close), high[i]]. Require a later second swing whose extreme falls inside that body-bounded band, then accept the zone only if ArrayMinimum(low) (ArrayMaximum(high)) from first swing to now never pierces the outer extreme—else discard as broken.
data_needed: CopyOpen/Close/Low/High/Time on timeframe; bars_check (~200); lookback z (~7); Bars count from first swing to now; rectangle objects for viz
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: _Symbol chart instrument; S/R TF inputs PERIOD_W1 or PERIOD_M30 (user-selectable ENUM_TIMEFRAMES); 200-bar lookback
why_new_for_mis: Objective dual-touch, body-thickness S/R with unbroken integrity is a reusable structural regime sensor MIS can emit as live zone levels without hand-drawn rectangles.
quote: After identifying this support zone, the EA confirms that no candle has broken below it. The zone is deemed illegitimate and not considered if any candle closes below it.

mechanism: Detect and validate S/R zones on a higher timeframe; only after a valid unbroken zone, switch to exe_timeframe OHLC (series arrays) and search for Change of Character structure that forms after the second zone touch (start_choch_time = time[j+z]). Trade only when LTF CHOCH confirms near the HTF zone—buy at support after bullish CHOCH, sell at resistance after bearish CHOCH—once per exe bar via lastTradeBarTime lock.
data_needed: Separate HTF and exe_timeframe Copy* arrays; start_choch_time anchor; currentBarTime vs lastTradeBarTime; lot_size and RRR for TP
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: _Symbol; S/R TF PERIOD_W1/PERIOD_M30; execution TF PERIOD_M5 or PERIOD_M30; 200 bars on both
why_new_for_mis: Explicit HTF structure + LTF structural-break gate is a clean multi-scale regime-change sensor stack MIS can run without discretionary timing.
quote: The lower timeframe is used to confirm entry by identifying a bullish change of character within or near the support and resistance zones that were first identified on a higher timeframe.

mechanism: On exe_timeframe with swing lookback 3, recover sequence lower_low → lower_high → intervening low_l (between LH and LL) → high_h above prior swings. Confirm bullish CHOCH when a candle opens below and closes above lower_high, with lower_low still inside the HTF support band and high_time after start_choch_time. SL at lower_low; TP = ask + (ask−lower_low)*RRR.
data_needed: exe_low/high/open/close/time; IsSwingLow/High(lookback=3); support band [first_sup_price, first_sup_min_body_price]; RRR
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: _Symbol; exe PERIOD_M5/M30 nested under HTF S/R; swing lookback 3
why_new_for_mis: Codified LL–LH–L–HH close-through-LH CHOCH is a discrete bullish structure-break event MIS can treat as a labeled regime-change tick at supports.
quote: When a bullish candle closes above the lower high that was previously created, it confirms a bullish change of character.

mechanism: Mirror of bullish CHOCH at resistance: on exe_timeframe recover higher_high → higher_low → intervening high_h (between HL and HH) → low_l below prior swings. Fire when a candle opens above and closes below higher_low, with higher_high still inside the HTF resistance band [first_res_max_body_price, first_res_price] and low_time > start_choch_time. Sell with SL at higher_high; TP = ask − (high_h−ask)*RRR.
data_needed: exe OHLC; IsSwingHigh/Low(lookback=3); resistance band; unbroken ArrayMaximum check on HTF highs
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: _Symbol; same HTF S/R + LTF exe pair as support side
why_new_for_mis: Symmetric HH–HL–H–LL close-through-HL CHOCH gives MIS a paired bearish structure-break sensor at dual-touch resistance.
quote: When a bearish candle closes below the pattern's higher low, it serves as the last confirmation.

mechanism: Full read: teaches WebRequest() GET/POST parameters (method, URL, headers, timeout, data[], result, result_headers), BotFather token/chat_id setup, and sendMessage/editMessageText/deleteMessage to Telegram bots/groups. No market regime, volatility, liquidity, or sequence sensing is constructed—only outbound messaging plumbing.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: None market (Telegram API https://api.telegram.org; MT5 Options Allow WebRequest URL whitelist)
why_new_for_mis: After full read this is an MQL5 language/integration tutorial for external messaging, not an MIS market sensing idea.
